blocks.content: Explore a finished dashboard to find its time series panels and read one value at one time.

blocks.title: Read a value at a time

blocks.content: Four panels draw a line across time: **Memory / CPU**, **logins**, **server requests**, and **client side full page load**. Each one answers the question: How has this value gone up and down over time?
Time runs along the horizontal axis and the number of requests up the vertical axis. The legend tells the two series apart.
Hover over the graph to read a timestamp and one series' value in the tooltip. Move to a later time and follow the same series to see whether it rises or falls.
A time series needs timestamped numeric values. A stat would reduce these samples to one number and hide the pattern.
Find **Lines** in the **Styles** row. Its neighbors **Points** and **Bars** draw the same kind of data two other ways.
The marks change. The timestamped values behind them don't.
You've found time series panels, read one series across time, and seen lines, points, and bars as three displays of the same kind of data.
